Garden events venue · Lusaka, Zambia

Room for everyone you love, under an open sky.

Ito's Ranch is a landscaped events garden on Makani Road with marquee lawns, a paved courtyard, a fishpond and plenty of secure parking. Weddings, birthdays, corporate days and family gatherings, hosted since August 2020.

The grounds

A walk through the ranch

Guests arrive along a palm-lined driveway, park on paved bays under solar street lights, and step onto lawns ready for a marquee of any size. Every space below is on one secure, walled site.
